newsitem.title: USA: White House says most budget decisions near.
newsitem.headline: White House says most budget decisions near.

text.p: The White House said President Clinton is immersed in budget matters and will complete most major budget decisions by the end of the week.

"A lot of the big-picture decisions that have to be made will be by and large wrapped up this week so that OMB (the Office of Management and Budget) can go to work finalizing the proposal," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
Clinton and his aides are working on a budget proposal for the next fiscal year to be submitted to Congress on or about Feb 3.
McCurry said Clinton was hearing final appeals from Cabinet officers looking to defend spending in their departments.

"By and large many of the issues are resolved but there are always in every budget cycle some issues that rise up to the president's attention and he has to hear from individual Cabinet members and give OMB instructions so that they can complete the budget," McCurry said.
